item.text: [{"task_id":"fea12743","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    ink = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    subset_color = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    largest_color = int(round(params['colors'][3]))","    start = int(round(params['layout'][0]))","    size = int(round(params['layout'][1]))","    stride = int(round(params['layout'][2]))","    unit = int(round(params['layout'][3]))","    out = grid.copy()","    if size <= 0 or stride <= 0 or start < 0 or unit != 1:","        return out","    if min(bg, ink, subset_color, largest_color) < 0 or max(bg, ink, subset_color, largest_color) > 9:","        return out","    blocks = []","    positions = []","    counts = []","    for r in range(start, grid.shape[0] - size + unit, stride):","        for c in range(start, grid.shape[1] - size + unit, stride):","            mask = grid[r:r + size, c:c + size] == ink","            blocks.append(mask)","            positions.append((r, c))","            counts.append(int(np.count_nonzero(mask)))","    if not blocks:","        return out","    winner = int(np.argmax(np.array(counts)))","    template = blocks[winner]","    for i in range(len(blocks)):","        r, c = positions[i]","        mask = blocks[i]","        color = ink","        if i == winner:","            color = largest_color","        elif np.all(np.logical_or(np.logical_not(mask), template)):","            color = subset_color","        region = out[r:r + size, c:c + size]","        region[mask] = color","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[4],"layout":[4]},"params":{"colors":[0,2,8,3],"layout":[1,4,5,1]},"rationale":"The object with the most red cells becomes green. Other objects become azure exactly when their red cells are a subset of the green object's red cells at the same local coordinates. All remaining objects retain red."}]
